newsitem.title: NORWAY: Aker Maritime wins Shell Draugen oil deal.
newsitem.headline: Aker Maritime wins Shell Draugen oil deal.

text.p: Norwegian offshore services company Aker Maritime ASA said on Wednesday it had been awarded a framework contract by Norske Shell for modification work on the Draugen oil platform in the Norwegian Sea.
No exact value was given for the deal, but an Aker spokesman said it was worth "several hundred million crowns".

The work involved upgrade work on Draugen and the planning of possible new field development for Norske Shell. The agreement also contains an option for maintenance on Draugen, Aker said in a statement.
The contract runs for an initial three years with extension options for up to another four years.
